purpose: Additional analytical countercheck before applying the spatially flat v11 temperature formula to a closed no-boundary saddle.
background: Global de Sitter a(t)=cosh(H_Lambda t)/H_Lambda, k=+1, with a regular Euclidean hemisphere and the standard Euclidean/Bunch-Davies state.
imported_QFT_input: A geodesic observer in this state has exact Gibbons-Hawking temperature H_Lambda/(2 pi). This imported theorem is not rederived by the code.
calculation: Compare the geometric expression (a double dot/a dot)/(2 pi)=H_Lambda coth(H_Lambda t)/(2 pi). At fixed N, epsilon_H=Omega_K=-1/(exp(2N)-1); the relative discrepancy is sqrt(1+abs(Omega_K))-1, linear in |Omega_K|. Record this separately from the flat conformal-field test.
implication: The v11 flat-geometry restriction is essential. A curved no-boundary transfer must calculate curvature corrections or impose an explicit small-curvature matching limit.
